title: The hot spots conjecture for simply connected planar domains

result.label: The hot spots conjecture for simply connected planar domains
result.statement: Proves a strict form of Burdzy's simply connected hot spots conjecture. On every smooth bounded simply connected planar domain, each nonzero eigenfunction for the first positive Neumann eigenvalue has no interior critical point, so all global extrema lie on the boundary. Eigenvalue multiplicity is allowed.
